basicinfo_fields.name: report_code
basicinfo_fields.notes: Format: [Broker]-[Ticker]-[Name]-[YYYYMMDD]. PRIMARY KEY of vrn_basic_info table. Unique constraint enforced by DB.

basicinfo_fields.name: broker
basicinfo_fields.notes: Multi-layer alias matching. 17 canonical brokers in V22_2_FINAL; Extension adds 10. Each via_ regex (?<![A-Za-z0-9])X(?![A-Za-z0-9]) word boundary safe.

basicinfo_fields.name: analyst
basicinfo_fields.notes: HuaNan-specific adapter implemented (entrust.com.tw email pairing). Other brokers fall back to general extractor.

basicinfo_fields.name: ticker
basicinfo_fields.notes: Year-band disambiguation REQUIRED for 2021-2030. See VIS_VRN_TickerFilenameSSOT.

basicinfo_fields.name: rating
basicinfo_fields.notes: Use S01 RATING_LIST flat for case-insensitive matching. RATING_FLAT_LIST is the iterable form.

basicinfo_fields.name: rating_cat
rescue_hooks: Normalize from `rating` via VRN_RATING_ALIASES_V22_2_FINAL inverse map

basicinfo_fields.name: adj_close
basicinfo_fields.notes: MUST use ADJ Close (post ex-dividend / capital change adjusted), not raw Close. VDF DuckDB stores both; use prices.adj_close column.

basicinfo_fields.name: upside_pct
basicinfo_fields.notes: Computed: (target_price / adj_close - 1) * 100. Both inputs must be non-null. upside_source records the adj_close timestamp used.
